statutory.question: Does the conduct described fall within 31 U.S.C. § 5318(g) — Suspicious activity reporting requirements?
statutory.label: contradiction
statutory.reasoning: The statute applies only to financial institutions; the entity is a business, not a covered financial institution, so the duty to file a SAR under § 5318(g) requires is not triggered. Consequently, the conduct does not satisfy the statutory element of being subject to the reporting obligation.
